_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gold-miner signals with Newmont's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Newmont is one of the world’s largest gold producers and is the only gold company included in the S&P 500 Index and Fortune 500, and was the first gold company included in the Dow Jones Sustainability Index-World.' 'One of the most significant risks is fluctuation in the prices of gold and copper, which are affected by numerous factors beyond our control.' 'A Substantial or Extended Decline in Gold or Copper Prices Would Have a Material Adverse Effect on Newmont' (the FY2008 10-K's own words; it does not call the business cyclical, so DURABLE, the MU rule)

classification.quality_note: 'Newmont is one of the world’s largest gold producers and is the only gold company included in the S&P 500 Index and Fortune 500, and was the first gold company included in the Dow Jones Sustainability Index-World.' 'One of the most significant risks is fluctuation in the prices of gold and copper, which are affected by numerous factors beyond our control.' 'A Substantial or Extended Decline in Gold or Copper Prices Would Have a Material Adverse Effect on Newmont' (the FY2008 10-K's own words; it does not call the business cyclical, so DURABLE, the MU rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.13x; -25% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.40; conservative 2yr +84%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -33.3%/yr (worst year FY02-FY08 ex-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -8.1%/yr (Q4 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.2-yr ex-FY07 median

BULL.desc: EPS +35.8%/yr (FY02-FY08 ex-FY07 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +79.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY08 ex-FY07, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NEM (retrospective, 2009-04-03) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.13x (55.2% downside to Bear $19.68 / +410.6% upside to Bull $224.11) | Adj composite 2.80 vs market 1.40: gap +1.40 [UNDERVALUED] | -25% above the EPP floor $58.24 (32x FY09E $1.82) | Conservative 2-yr case: +84.3% total (+42.2%/yr) | At 24.1x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $58.04 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue -4.8% YoY in Q4 2008, forward revenues -4.8% (Q4 2008 revenue growth (no revenue guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
